<robot name="sliding_cabinet">

      <geometry>
        <box size="0.02 0.37 1.09"/>

  <!-- Clearance: inside width approx 0.89 - 2*0.02 = 0.85 -->

  <!-- Front faces at -Y. Cabinet outer front at Y = -0.185, door center should be near -0.175. -->

  <link name="track_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="1.2"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0010" iyy="0.0005" izz="0.0010" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyz="0.0"/>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.2125 -0.175 0.75" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.425 0.02 0.03"/>

      <material name="track_metal"/>

      <geometry>
        <box size="0.425 0.02 0.03"/>

    <inertial>

           right door at x = +0.10625 (so they overlap around center when moving).
      -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.545" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.018" iyy="0.040" izz="0.058" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyz="0.0"/>

    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.10625 -0.175 0.545" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.425 0.02 1.09"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="door_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.545" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.018" iyy="0.040" izz="0.058" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyz="0.0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.10625 -0.175 0.545" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.425 0.02 1.09"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="door_wood"/>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.10625 -0.175 0.545" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.425 0.02 1.09"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="front_beam">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.015" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0040" iyy="0.0120" izz="0.0120" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyz="0.0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.175 0.55" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.89 0.02 0.03"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_front"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.175 0.55" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.89 0.02 0.03"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <joint name="joint_base_to_world" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="base_dummy"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Use a world link-less structure: define base as root and attach others to it -->
  <link name="base_dummy"/>

  <joint name="joint_back_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="back_panel"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0.185 0.545" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="left_side"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.445 0 0.545" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_right_side_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="right_side"/>
    <origin xyz="0.445 0 0.545" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_top_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="top_shelf"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 1.065" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_bottom_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="bottom_shelf"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0.025" rpy="0 0 0"/>

  <joint name="joint_track_left_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="track_left"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.2125 -0.175 0.75" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="joint_track_right_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="track_right"/>

    <child link="front_beam"/>
    <origin xyz="0 -0.175 0.55" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Sliding joints: doors move along X (left-right) sideways past each other -->

  <!-- Left door joint limits chosen so each door can traverse the full interior width. -->

  <joint name="joint_door_left" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="door_left"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.10625 -0.175 0.545" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="1 0 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.2125" upper="0.2125" effort="50" velocity="2"/>
